# Journal of Theoretical and Applied Information Technology (JATIT)

> A peer-reviewed open access academic journal publishing original research in information technology and theoretical computer science (ISSN 1992-8645, E-ISSN 1817-3195).

JATIT is an international academic journal based in Islamabad, Pakistan, indexed in Thomson Science Citation Index and Ulrich's. The journal maintains rigorous peer-review standards and welcomes manuscript submissions from researchers worldwide across IT and applied information technology domains.
